kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أنقرض (form VII)
# أَنْقَرِضُ (ʔanqariḍu) /ʔan.qa.ri.dˤu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِنْقَرَضَ (inqaraḍa)
# أَنْقَرِضَ (ʔanqariḍa) /ʔan.qa.ri.dˤa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْقَرَضَ (inqaraḍa)
# أَنْقَرِضْ (ʔanqariḍ) /ʔan.qa.ridˤ/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِنْقَرَضَ (inqaraḍa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
